checkbox.label: Use MSAA high quality optimization
checkbox.tooltip: Parameter to control MSAA optimization quality. If unchecked shader evaluated once for a group of 2x2 pixels.

textbox.tooltip: Changes the draw order of the mesh. Materials with smaller values are drawn first.

checkbox.label: Needs Electric Power
checkbox.tooltip: Intensity can be affected by electric disturbances.

checkbox.label: Affected By Time Of Day
checkbox.tooltip: Intensity will be affected by time of day.

checkbox.label: Invert Time Of Day (ON at day)
checkbox.tooltip: Inverts intensities to be on during day and off at night

combobox.tooltip: Light intensity curve that will be used when affected by time of day.

checkbox.label: Inverse
checkbox.tooltip: Inverses normal attenuation so that it fades in the middle and not on the edges

textbox.tooltip: All videos using same Bink file on the same channel will play in sync. 0 = not shared.

group.label: Video will play in sync with other videos using same Bink file on same channel.
Flipbook initial frame set by code for entities (default 0)
Only horizontal flipbooks are supported in ping-pong mode.
The flipbook animation is controled exclusivly by code. Initial frame is 0 by default.

checkbox.label: Enable Hologram Effect
checkbox.tooltip: Paramiters to add scanline and flickier effects

checkbox.label: Enable Screen Effect
checkbox.tooltip: Parameters to mimick giant LED screens.

checkbox.label: Use LED RGB Pixels
checkbox.tooltip: Parameter to mimick LED RGB pixel pattern.

checkbox.label: Enable ResponsiveAA
checkbox.tooltip: Parameter to make TAA pass through the emissive material avoiding smudging.
